map.市盈率（PE）计算器。输入股价与每股收益，求市盈率估值倍数，用于股票相对估值与同: P/E ratio calculator. Enter the share price and earnings per share to get the valuation multiple, used for relative stock valuation and peer comparison.
map.P/E = 股价 / 每股收益: P/E = share price / earnings per share
map.股价相对于盈利的估值倍数。: The valuation multiple of the share price relative to earnings.
map.填写「每股收益 EPS」。: Enter the earnings per share EPS.
map.看股价相对盈利的贵贱。: See how expensive the share price is relative to earnings.
map.同行对比估值高低。: Compare valuation levels side by side within the same industry.
map.用每股市价除以每股收益，快速判断估值贵贱。: Divide the market price per share by earnings per share for a quick read on valuation.
map.：P/E = 60/3 = 20 倍。即按当前盈利需 20 年回本（未折现）。: P/E = 60/3 = 20 times, meaning it would take 20 years of current earnings to pay back (undiscounted).
map.股价 45 元、每股收益 EPS 3 元: Share price 45 CNY, earnings per share EPS 3 CNY
map.：PE=45/3=15.00 倍，含义是按当前盈利水平静态推算，约需 15 年的: PE = 45/3 = 15.00 times, meaning that at the current earnings level a static calculation says it takes about 15 years of total profit to pay back (not yet counting earnings growth).
map.由两资产权重与 β 求组合 β: Portfolio beta from two asset weights and betas
map.由未来值、贴现率与年数求现值: Present value from the future value, discount rate and number of years
map.由名义收益率与通胀率求实际收益率: Real return from the nominal return and the inflation rate
map.P/E 低一定便宜？: Is a low P/E always cheap?
map.低 P/E 可能盈利将下滑或周期顶部；高 P/E 可能高成长。要结合增速(EPE: A low P/E may mean earnings are about to fall or the cycle is at its peak; a high P/E may mean high growth. Judge it together with the growth rate (EPEG) and earnings quality.
map.PE 为负是什么意思？: What does a negative PE mean?
map.公司亏损时 EPS 为负，PE 也随之变负并失去估值参考价值，此时可改用市销率: When a company loses money EPS is negative, so the PE also turns negative and loses its valuation reference value; at that point use the price-to-sales (PS) or price-to-book (PB) ratio instead. Cyclical stocks also show artificially high PE at the trough of earnings, which is a classic valuation trap.
